title.en: 2026 Grain Harvest in the Zone Completed at 486,300 Tonnes
title.ir: IAEZde 2026-jylky dan tüshümü 486 300 tonnaga jetti
title.ru: Урожай зерновых 2026 года в Зоне собран: 486 300 тонн

summary.en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources has announced the completion of the 2026 grain harvest at 486,300 tonnes, the best result in several seasons. The Ministry credits good spring water, the April canal rotations and the irrigation modernisation programme.
summary.ir: Ayyl charba jana suu resurstary ministrligi 2026-jylky dan jyynoo bütkönün jarialady: jalpy 486 300 tonna, songku bir nechche mezgildin eng jakshy natyjasy.
summary.ru: Министерство сельского хозяйства и водных ресурсов объявило о завершении уборки зерновых 2026 года: собрано 486 300 тонн — лучший результат за несколько сезонов.

en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources announced on Saturday that the 2026 grain harvest in the Irad Special Economic Zone is complete and totals 486,300 tonnes. The Ministry described the result as the best in several seasons.

Wheat accounted for the largest share, at about 214,000 tonnes. Maize followed with 148,000 tonnes, much of it from the Kara-Bulak and Chu fields. Barley added 71,000 tonnes and Chu rice 31,000 tonnes, with a further 22,300 tonnes of other grains and pulses.

The grain came mainly from Chu District, Talas District and the lower plain of Kara-Buura District. The Ministry noted that good spring water and the canal rotations, published each April, allowed farmers to plan sowing and watering with confidence.

Minister of Agriculture and Water Resources Melis Nurmatov thanked the farmers of the three districts. "The irrigation modernisation of recent years is now visible in the field, and the farmers of Chu, Talas and Kara-Buura have earned the thanks of the whole Zone," the Minister said.

At the close of the harvest the Kara-Bulak depot and the Nurzhan terminal reported their grain stores filled. The Ministry said grain will be drawn down through the winter as mills and feed producers take deliveries.

Attention now turns to preparing canals and fields for the 2027 sowing. The Ministry will continue its work with farmers and water users to ensure that the coming season is as well planned as this one.

title.en: More Residents Turn to Police Family Desks as Reports of Violence in the Home Reach 2,940
title.ir: Üy-bülödögü zombuluk boyuncha arydar 17 payyzga östü
title.ru: Всё больше жителей обращаются в семейные столы полиции: зарегистрировано 2 940 сообщений о домашнем насилии

summary.en: The Ministry of Internal Security today published its public-order summary for January to October 2026, which records 2,940 reports of violence in the home across the Zone, up 17% on the same months of 2025. The Ministry describes the increase as a sign that residents are turning to the authorities.
summary.ir: Ichki Koopsuzduk Ministrligi bügün 2026-jyldyn on ayy boyuncha ayyntysyn jarykka chygardy: üy-bülödögü zombuluk boyuncha 2 940 arz kattalgan, bul 2025-jyl menen salyshtyrganda 17 payyzga köp. Ministrlik munu turgundardyn biylikke kayrylyshynyn belgisi dep sanayt.
summary.ru: Министерство внутренней безопасности опубликовало сводку по общественному порядку за январь–октябрь 2026 года: по зоне зарегистрировано 2 940 сообщений о насилии в семье, на 17% больше, чем за те же месяцы 2025 года. В министерстве видят в этом признак того, что жители всё чаще обращаются к властям.

en: The Ministry of Internal Security today published its public-order summary for the first ten months of 2026. It records 2,940 reports of violence in the home across the Irad Special Economic Zone from January to October, compared with 2,513 in the same period of 2025, an increase of 17%.

By city and district, Talas registered about 1,210 reports and Nurzhan about 960. Iyık Janyl recorded about 330, and the six districts together about 440. The figures cover the Zone only. The elders' courts of the autonomous tribal regions keep their own records.

The Ministry's summary describes the increase as a sign that residents are turning to the authorities. Police press officers note that the city police family desks have become better known, and that callers now include neighbours and relatives as well as those directly affected.

"People know there is a family desk at the station and that someone there will take the call seriously," said Maj. Kanat Abdyrakhmanov, press officer of the Talas City Police. "We count that as trust."

In Nurzhan, Capt. Yelena Gavrilyuk said the city's figure reflects more callers coming forward. In Talas, the shelter Baspana, which has 30 places for women and children and is supported by the Sisters of the Cross and private donors, reported that its hotline has been busier this year.

The Ministry of Internal Security encourages anyone who needs help to contact the family desk at the nearest city police station or district detachment. The twelve-month figures are expected in January.

title.en: Antimony Combine's Five Years: US$172 Million to the Budget in Three, and the Sary-Bulak Restart Under Way
title.ir: Surma kombinatynyn besh jyly: üch jylda budjetke 172 million dollar, Sary-Bulak kaytadan ishke kirishüüdö
title.ru: Пять лет сурьмяного комбината: 172 млн долларов в бюджет за три года, перезапуск в Сары-Булаке идёт

summary.en: The Iradi Antimony and Rare Metals Combine's 2021–2025 management accounts show about US$905 million of revenue and US$172 million paid to the ISEZ budget in 2023–2025. The Combine's earnings are now funding the Sary-Bulak Restart Programme, which aims at about 420 permanent posts.
summary.ir: Irad Surma jana Seyrek Metaldar Kombinatynyn 2021–2025-jyldardagy hesabynda 905 million dollarga jakyn tabysh körsötülgön; 2023–2025-jyldary ISEZ budjetine 172 million dollar tölöngön. Kirishter Sary-Bulaktyn kaytadan ishke kirishüü programmasyna jumshalat.
summary.ru: Управленческая отчётность Иradского сурьмяно-редкометалльного комбината за 2021–2025 годы показывает около 905 млн долларов выручки и 172 млн долларов, выплаченных в бюджет ОЭЗИ в 2023–2025 годах. Доходы направляются на программу перезапуска в Сары-Булаке, рассчитанную примерно на 420 постоянных рабочих мест.

en: The Iradi Antimony and Rare Metals Combine (IARMC), which operates the Sary-Bulak Antimony Works and the Chatkal smelter, has published a five-year summary of its management accounts for 2021–2025 on iarmc.com. The summary shows about US$905 million of revenue and about US$190 million of net profit, roughly 1.6 billion som at the Bank of Irad's official rate of 8.40 per dollar. As with the Combine's earlier yearly sets, the figures are management data and are not independently audited.

Revenue rose to US$140 million in 2023, US$236 million in 2024 and US$341 million in 2025, as prices strengthened after China tightened its antimony export controls. The two most recent years account for nearly two-thirds of the five-year total.

The Combine's payments to the budget of the Irad Special Economic Zone were US$34 million in 2023, US$56 million in 2024 and US$82 million in 2025, US$172 million in all. They were made as royalties, export duty and profit tax through the Irad Foreign Trade Escrow Authority, and amount to about a quarter of the Combine's revenue for those three years.

The earnings are now being put back into the works. Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat announced the Restart Programme to the labour collective at Sary-Bulak on 12 October. Its first stage costs 168 million som and aims at about 420 permanent posts. Recruitment opened on 26 October, with priority for residents of Talas and Sary-Bulak districts; company buses run from Talas. The Combine's two equipment and supply partners are to be named at signing before the end of the year. The Ministry of Natural Resources, headed by Minister Chingiz Asanov, is represented on the Combine's Supervisory Board.

The next public step is a hearing on the mercury recovery unit, which would need a new permit before it could resume work. It is due at the Rudnik house of culture on 26 November, and written comments are accepted until 10 December. The Mejlis budget committee is meanwhile preparing the 2027 draft budget.

title.en: Sales Tax on Pump Fuel Rises 9% to 468 Million Som in Ten Months
title.ir: Küyüüchü mayga satuu salygy on ayda 9% östü: 468 million som
title.ru: Налог с продаж на топливо на АЗС за десять месяцев вырос на 9% и составил 468 млн сомов

summary.en: The State Tax Service reports 468 million som in sales tax on retail fuel in January–October 2026, up 9% on a year earlier, with pump prices unchanged. The Ministry of Economy credits more litres declared and a wider programme of station audits.
summary.ir: Mamlekettik Salyk kyzmaty 2026-jyldyn yanvar–oktyabrynda küyüüchü maydyn chekene satuusunan 468 million som satuu salygy chogultkanyn bildirdi. Ekonomika ministrligi östüünü tekserüü jana jarialangan litrler köböygönü menen tüshündürdü.
summary.ru: Государственная налоговая служба сообщила, что налог с продаж на розничное топливо за январь–октябрь 2026 года составил 468 млн сомов, на 9% больше, чем годом ранее, при неизменных ценах на АЗС. Министерство экономики связывает рост с увеличением заявленных литров и более широкой программой проверок станций.

en: The State Tax Service collected 468 million som in sales tax on retail fuel in January–October 2026, the Ministry of Economy announced on Wednesday. The figure is 9% higher than the 429 million som recorded in the same ten months of 2025. It covers petrol and diesel sold at filling stations in Talas, Nurzhan, Iyık Janyl and the six districts.

The increase did not come from higher prices. Pump prices were unchanged throughout the period, at 5.40 som a litre for AI-92, 5.85 som for AI-95 and 6.10 som for diesel. Sales tax in the Irad Special Economic Zone is charged at 12%, with no VAT, under the Tax Code 2009.

The State Tax Service, headed by Nadezhda Kovalenko, credits the result to two factors: more litres declared by filling stations, and a larger number of station audits. In the audits, inspectors matched stations' till records against delivery figures from NurGaz and from independent depots.
The Ministry's press secretary, Bekbolot Sherov, said the result "shows that the pumps are being declared". He added that the audit programme will continue into the new year.
The Ministry of Economy drafts the annual budget, and the Governor's office sends it to the Mejlis in November. The Ministry will publish a summary of the 2027 draft in the usual way.

title.en: Five-Year Roads Record: 340 km Laid, 112 Machines Added, 38 Snowploughs for the Passes
title.ir: Besh jyldyk jol boyuncha esep: 340 km jol, 112 tehnika, 38 kar tazalagych
title.ru: Пятилетний итог дорожных работ: 340 км дорог, 112 единиц техники, 38 снегоочистителей для перевалов

summary.en: The Ministry of Transport and the Department of Infrastructure and Communications have published the roads record for 2022–2026: 340 km paved or resurfaced, 112 units of machinery bought or replaced, and 4.1 billion som invested.
summary.ir: Transport ministrligi jana Infrastruktura jana baylanysh departamenti 2022–2026-jyldardagy jol boyuncha esepti jarialady: 340 km jol, 112 tehnika, 4,1 milliard som.
summary.ru: Министерство транспорта и Департамент инфраструктуры и связи опубликовали итоги дорожной программы 2022–2026 годов: 340 км дорог уложено или обновлено, закуплено или заменено 112 единиц техники, вложено 4,1 млрд сомов.

en: The Ministry of Transport and the Department of Infrastructure and Communications this month published the five-year roads record for 2022–2026, closing the books on the 2026 building season.

The record counts 340 km of the Special Economic Zone's roughly 4,800 km of public roads newly paved or resurfaced over the five years. Most of the length lies on the Trans-Talas Highway between Talas, Kyzyl-Adyr and Talas North Terminal, and on the lowland Talas–Nurzhan road. A number of city avenues in Nurzhan are included in the total.

The road fleet was strengthened as well: 112 units of road machinery were bought or replaced, among them pavers, rollers and graders, and 38 snowploughs for the pass depots. Spending on paving and machinery across the five years came to 4.1 billion som.
The works were carried out by contractors including Nurzhandorstroy, the Nurzhan road builder led by General Director Oleg Mironenko, which won the larger share of the contract value.
Transport Minister Oleg Rudenko said the programme had kept the main freight corridors moving. "A road is judged in January, when the snow comes, not at the ribbon-cutting," he said.

The ministry said the new winter equipment will go first to the Fergana Gateway and Toguz-Bulak depots, which keep State Route 1 and the Kök-Bel road open through the cold season. The Department of Infrastructure and Communications, headed by Director Arstan Medetov, will continue to publish the record of kilometres laid each year.

title.en: 118 Teacher-Trainers Complete Four-Week STEAM and Inclusive-Classroom Course
title.ir: 118 mugalim-trener tört aptalyk kurstan sertifikat aldy
title.ru: 118 учителей-тренеров завершили четырёхнедельный курс по STEAM и инклюзивному обучению

summary.en: The Ministry of Education has certified 118 senior teachers and district methodists after a four-week course at the Research Institute of Pedagogy in Talas. The trainers will now lead school-based sessions, with the aim of reaching about 4,000 teachers by June 2027.
summary.ir: Bilim ministrligi Talastagy Pedagogika ilim-izildöö institutunda tört apta okugan 118 mugalimge sertifikat tapshyrdy. Trenerler mektepterde sabak ötköröt, 2027-jyldyn iyununa cheyin 4 000 ge jakyn mugalimge jetmekchi.
summary.ru: Министерство образования вручило сертификаты 118 старшим учителям и районным методистам, прошедшим четырёхнедельный курс в Научно-исследовательском институте педагогики в Таласе. Тренеры проведут занятия в школах, чтобы охватить около 4 000 учителей к июню 2027 года.

en: On Friday 20 November the Ministry of Education presented certificates to 118 senior teachers and district methodists who completed a four-week training course at the Research Institute of Pedagogy in Talas. The course ran from 19 October to 13 November 2026.

The programme covered three subjects: STEAM lessons, in which science, technology, engineering, arts and mathematics are taught through projects; the teaching of mixed classes that include children with disabilities and learning difficulties; and the way a school plans its own small budget.

Practice lessons were held at Talas Secondary School No. 31, whose headmistress, Gulmira Saparbek, opened the school's classrooms to the trainees. In one lesson, pupils combined a small robotics task with a weaving pattern under the guidance of informatics teacher Nurgul Abdykadyrova, who has taught at the school since 2004.

Dinara Seitkulova, head of the Ministry's curriculum section, said the course was designed to fit the existing textbooks and thematic plans. "Nothing here asks a teacher to throw out the lesson plan," she said. "It shows how a project can sit inside one."

Each of the certified trainers will now lead school-based sessions in their own district. The Ministry's target is to reach about 4,000 teachers by June 2027. The Iyik Janyl Pedagogical College and the Education Network of the ISEZ (iradedu.org) will carry the course materials to schools in the eastern districts and the Chu belt.
Education Minister Kanykei Umotova thanked the staff of the Research Institute of Pedagogy and the host school for their work in preparing and delivering the course.

title.en: Lower Naryn District Registers 71 New Firms in Nine Months
title.ir: Tömönkü Naryn aimagynda toguz ayda 71 jaña firma katalga alyndy
title.ru: В Нижненарынском районе за девять месяцев зарегистрировано 71 новое предприятие

summary.en: The Lower Naryn District Administration reports 71 new firms registered between January and September 2026, against 52 a year earlier, with about 520 jobs declared. Fruit and walnut processing leads the list, and Bazar-Korgon accounts for 31 of the new firms.
summary.ir: Tömönkü Naryn aimagynyn administratsiyasy 2026-jyldyn yanvar-sentyabrynda 71 jaña firma katalga alynganyn bildirdi, buga čeyin 52 bolgon. Jaña firmalar 520 jumush orunun jarıyalady; Bazar-Korgonda 31 firma katalga alyndy.
summary.ru: Администрация Нижненарынского района сообщила о регистрации 71 нового предприятия в январе–сентябре 2026 года против 52 годом ранее; заявлено около 520 рабочих мест. На Базар-Коргон приходится 31 новая фирма.

en: The Lower Naryn District Administration announced on Monday that 71 new firms were registered in the district between January and September 2026, against 52 in the same nine months of 2025, a rise of more than a third.

About 18 firms in the district were struck off over the same period, leaving a net gain of 53. Bazar-Korgon accounts for 31 of the new registrations and Tash-Kömür, the district seat, for 17. The remainder are spread across the farm-belt towns and villages. Together, the new firms have declared about 520 jobs, or roughly seven each.

Fruit and walnut processing and drying lead the list, followed by repair workshops, building firms and haulage. The pattern follows the trade of the Fergana rim, where orchards and walnut groves supply the Bazar-Korgon market and a growing number of families choose to dry, shell and pack the harvest themselves.

"These are small firms doing ordinary work," said Alisher Kholmatov, head of the district administration. "A drying shed, a workshop, a lorry and two drivers. That is how a district's economy is built, and I am glad to see so many people willing to register and put their names to it."

Bekbolot Sherov, press secretary of the Ministry of Economy, confirmed that the figures are drawn from entries in the Register of Firms that the ministry passed to the district administration. The count covers Lower Naryn District only; Iyık Janyl, a separate city, is not included.

The Territorial Statistics Office is conducting a census of business entities under Executive Directive 2026/24 until 30 November, and for the first time is counting bazaar stalls and farms. The district administration will review the full-year figures in the new year, once the census results are available.

title.en: Talas Civil Air Terminal Has Room to Grow Ahead of Summer 2027 Planning
title.ir: Talas aeroportunda orun bar
title.ru: Гражданский терминал Таласа готов принимать больше рейсов

summary.en: The Talas Civil Air Terminal handles about 150 passengers an hour and has capacity to take more flights, as Iradiya prepares its summer 2027 programme. The Ministry of Transport thanks the partners whose clearances keep the five present routes running.
summary.ir: Talas aeroportu saatyna 150 jürgünchü kabyl alat. 2025-jyly 41 000 jürgünchü kyzmat alyshty.
summary.ru: Гражданский терминал Таласа обслуживает около 150 пассажиров в час и располагает запасом мощности, пока «Ирадия» готовит летнюю программу 2027 года. Министерство транспорта благодарит партнёров, чьи разрешения обеспечивают работу пяти действующих направлений.

en: The Talas Civil Air Terminal has the capacity to handle more flights than it does today, the Ministry of Transport said on Thursday, as Iradiya prepares to set its summer 2027 timetable.

The terminal, run by the Civil Aviation Directorate of the Ministry of Transport, handles about 150 passengers an hour. It carried about 41,000 passengers in 2025. Kamila Rakhmatova, the terminal's duty manager, said the building is not what limits the list of destinations. "Our limit is not the check-in hall or the apron," she said.

The winter schedule, which runs from 25 October 2026 to 27 March 2027, is flown entirely by Iradiya. It serves Tash-Kömür, Almaty on Wednesdays and Saturdays, Tashkent on Thursdays, Dubai on Mondays and Istanbul on Fridays. The Istanbul flight, operated with an E190, makes a technical stop at Baku.

Iradiya's international services are flown as weekly series, and each series requires landing and overflight clearances from neighbouring states. The Ministry of Transport thanks the partners whose clearances are already in hand and which keep the five present routes running week after week.

Several options are under discussion for the summer season: a second weekly series to Istanbul or Antalya, a second Almaty day, and an additional summer Tashkent flight. No decision has been taken. No new route has been announced, and neither the Ministry of Transport nor Iradiya has approved a new service.

The terminal charge remains 50 som on domestic flights and 600 som on international flights, payable in cash. Iradiya is expected to publish its summer programme once the clearance position is settled. Passengers planning travel for next summer are advised to follow the airline's own announcements.

title.en: New 150-Bed Hospital Planned for Tash-Kömür
title.ir: Tash-Kömürdö 150 orundoo jañy oorukana
title.ru: Новая больница на 150 коек планируется в Таш-Кёмюре

summary.en: The Ministry of Health announced that a Gulf development fund has indicated it will provide US$22 million toward a new multi-profile hospital of about 150 beds at Tash-Kömür. The site and design come first, with the ISEZ funding them from the 2027 budget.
summary.ir: Densooluk saktoo ministrligi Körföz regionundagy bir ösüü fondu Tash-Kömürdö jañy oorukana üçün 22 million dollar bermek nietin bildirgenin kabar kyldy. Aldyn ala jer jana proekt ishtelet; kelishim kol koyulgan emes.
summary.ru: Министерство здравоохранения сообщило, что фонд развития из стран Персидского залива выразил намерение предоставить 22 млн долларов США на новую многопрофильную больницу примерно на 150 коек в Таш-Кёмюре. Сначала будут подготовлены площадка и проект.

en: The Ministry of Health announced on 23 November that a Gulf development fund has indicated it will provide US$22 million, about 185 million som at the official rate, toward a new multi-profile hospital of about 150 beds at Tash-Kömür.

The plan was presented at the Lower Naryn District administration by the Minister of Health, Dr Jamila Kubatova, and the district head, Alisher Kholmatov. The new hospital would replace the wards of the Lower Naryn district hospital, much of which dates from the Soviet years.

The Ministry stated clearly where the project stands. An exchange of letters has taken place and no agreement has been signed. No start date, contractor or final cost has been set, and details will be published once an agreement is signed. "The site and the design come first," Dr Kubatova said.

The Government of the ISEZ would fund the site works and design from the 2027 budget, which is being submitted to the Mejlis this month. Mr Kholmatov said the hospital would serve both the health of the district's residents and its employment, bringing skilled jobs to Tash-Kömür.

At present, serious surgical cases from Lower Naryn and Iyık Janyl are referred to the Regional Hospital in Talas, about seven hours away by road. Care closer to home would save patients' families time and ease the load on the Regional Hospital's wards, as its chief physician, Dr Yosep Temirkulov, has noted.
The Ministry placed the proposal within the Lieutenant Governor's health agenda, alongside the 24 new ambulances delivered on 16 November to the Regional Hospital and the rural health posts.

title.en: Iradenergo to Study Floating Solar Pilot on Kyzyl-Adyr Reservoir
title.ir: Iradenergo Kyzyl-Adyr suu saktagychyndagy jüzgön kün stantsiyasyn izildeyt
title.ru: «Ирадэнерго» изучит возможность плавучей солнечной электростанции на Кызыл-Адырском водохранилище

summary.en: Iradenergo, the state power utility, will carry out a feasibility study of a pilot floating solar array of about 2 MW on the Kyzyl-Adyr Reservoir in Kara-Buura District. A donor fund is financing the study, which is put at about US$350,000.
summary.ir: Iradenergo Kara-Buura aimagyndagy Kyzyl-Adyr suu saktagychynda 2 MVt gana jüzgön kün stantsiyasynyn pilottuk proektin izildeyt. Izildöönü donor fondu karjylayt, aksasy 350 000 AKSh dollaryna jakyn.
summary.ru: «Ирадэнерго» проведёт технико-экономическое изучение пилотной плавучей солнечной электростанции мощностью около 2 МВт на Кызыл-Адырском водохранилище в Кара-Буурииском районе. Изучение, оцениваемое примерно в 350 тысяч долларов США, финансирует донорский фонд.

en: Iradenergo, the state power utility, announced on Tuesday 24 November that it will study a small floating solar array on the Kyzyl-Adyr Reservoir in Kara-Buura District. A donor fund will finance the feasibility study, which is put at about US$350,000.

The working concept is a pilot of around 2 MW on the water. Iradenergo would purchase the output, as it already does from the Talas Solar Park on the Boz-Tektir terrace. The reservoir lies close to an existing grid line, which would keep connection work modest.

Iradenergo spokesman Vladislav Ten stressed the nature of the undertaking. "This is a study, not a decision to build," he said. Floating panels generate power around midday, while the winter evening peak between 18:00 and 22:00 continues to be carried by the Toktogul Hydroelectric Station and the Naryn cascade.

Toktogul remains the backbone of the zone's winter supply. The Toktogul reservoir stood at 81.5 per cent full on 24 November and is following its usual drawdown through the cold season. Because of the size of its seasonal swings in level, floating panels are being considered only for the smaller Kyzyl-Adyr water.
Kara-Buura District head Jyrgalbek Osmonaliev welcomed the study, noting that it would give the district a chance to contribute to the zone's power supply alongside the large hydro stations.

The study will also examine how an array would perform through the reservoir's yearly changes in level. The Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources and the Talas basin irrigators will be consulted on the use of the reservoir water. Iradenergo will make the results public once the study is complete.
